story.hook: The museum wall reveals a hidden route
story.caption_explanation_en: A stealth infiltrator clings safely beside a gallery split where pencil shavings conceal a golden fish and steaming shadows swim.

images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5 cinematic museum-heist frame inside a polar ice expedition gallery with a crystalline crevasse. An attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. As a stealth museum infiltrator in an original matte-black utility vest using harmless theatrical tools, the cat shows wink-like one-eye squint and dramatic wall cling on a low wall with invisible support. A safe cinematic wire crosses between exhibit towers as a rescue route. The museum world split divides a real icy gallery from a painted-looking polar landscape. A miniature pencil-sharpener miner discovers a golden fish fragment in pencil shavings, while steam from a winter fish-cake stall contains a swimming fish shadow. Camera distance three meters, side-on wall-height viewpoint, 60mm lens, shallow depth of field with cat and split frame sharp, cold gallery LEDs, warm steam glow, realistic claws, paw pads, wall contact, ice reflections, and wire tension. Clearly staged safe film-set photography, no fall or injury. Correct feline anatomy, no duplicate cats, no extra limbs, no human features, no cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, or readable title.
